policy.update: Ordinary rebuilds reconcile exact top-level versions. Sunday 05:00 on the mini selects registry releases at least seven days old and not flagged by OSV, commits, installs, smoke-checks, then pushes only passing pins. OSV-known fixes for current vulnerabilities may bypass age. The laptop receives passed pins through its daily fast-forward pull.
policy.npm: Exact npm versions with --ignore-scripts; Homebrew owns node and npm. Transitive dependency resolution remains the package publisher's responsibility, not a fully vendored dependency lock.
policy.uv: Exact isolated tool versions; MLX compatibility pins never auto-bump.
policy.external: Exact GitHub Release versions and platform sha256 digests. No self-updaters.
policy.python: Only exact declared global Python libraries and their dependencies remain. Undeclared pip libraries are removed; PIP_REQUIRE_VIRTUALENV=1 blocks ad-hoc global installs.
policy.pi: Effective settings overlay exact npm package pins without modifying the authored settings.json; Git packages require immutable commits and local checkouts stay local. No model calls or agent reviewer in the update path.
